card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 23.2 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, VZ Pup: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 97.3 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 4,134 parsecs away.
